name: The Freedom Of God
overview: Scripture reveals that the freedom of God is demonstrated through His sovereign choice in salvation, as no one can come to Christ unless the Father grants it (John 6:65), and Jesus Himself is the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6). This divine freedom is also shown in God's loving initiative to give His only begotten Son so that believers receive eternal life (John 3:16). Believers are chosen and ordained by Christ to bear lasting fruit and to confidently approach the Father in prayer (John 15:16), while steadfast adherence to apostolic teaching and fellowship sustains their spiritual walk (Acts 2:42). The gospel, unashamedly proclaimed, is the powerful means by which God brings salvation to all who believe, transcending ethnic boundaries (Romans 1:16).
